rationale: Cannot freeze immobilization chemistry until enzyme identity is frozen. Different enzymes require different immobilization strategies.

candidate_immobilization_strategies.name: Covalent attachment to membrane surface (EDC/NHS coupling)
candidate_immobilization_strategies.evidence_for: Well-established chemistry. Stable for weeks-months in aqueous environment.
candidate_immobilization_strategies.evidence_against: May reduce enzyme activity by 30-70% (active site occlusion). Chronic stability (>1 year) unproven.
candidate_immobilization_strategies.key_question: What activity retention can we achieve at 30 days, 180 days, 5 years?

candidate_immobilization_strategies.name: Encapsulation in sol-gel silica
candidate_immobilization_strategies.evidence_for: Mild conditions. High surface area. Tunable pore size.
candidate_immobilization_strategies.evidence_against: Silica may fragment in CSF flow. Long-term mechanical integrity unknown.
candidate_immobilization_strategies.key_question: Can sol-gel maintain structural integrity under pulsatile CSF flow for 5 years?

candidate_immobilization_strategies.name: Polyethylene glycol (PEG) hydrogel entrapment
candidate_immobilization_strategies.evidence_for: Biocompatible. Tunable mesh size. Used in existing implantable enzyme systems (e.g., glucose sensor membranes).
candidate_immobilization_strategies.evidence_against: Hydrogel swelling may change over time. Enzyme leaching possible.
candidate_immobilization_strategies.key_question: What is the leaching rate of NEP from PEG hydrogel into CSF?

candidate_immobilization_strategies.name: Molecular imprinting (enzyme becomes part of polymer matrix)
candidate_immobilization_strategies.compatible_enzymes: Theoretical — not yet demonstrated for NEP
candidate_immobilization_strategies.evidence_against: Mostly research-stage. No chronic implantation data.
candidate_immobilization_strategies.status: RESEARCH — not viable for P-04 V1

decision_required: Select immobilization strategy based on enzyme identity (item 01) and chronic stability testing (item 04). Cannot freeze until both are resolved.
blocking_work_required: Test 2-3 candidate immobilization strategies in vitro
Measure: activity retention over 30 days, leaching rate, mechanical integrity under flow
constitutional_basis: Article XXXIV — chemistry is the next bottleneck, not code.
